groups.saying_opens: لبيك اللهم لبيك لبيك لا شريك لك
كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يركع بذي

notes: two sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): the talbiya relayed through Salim from his father, and the two rak'as at Dhu al-Hulayfa relayed by Ibn Umar himself («وإن عبد الله بن عمر كان يقول»)
«أباه» is Salim's father, a relation; the text does not write his name here, and the Ibn Umar link is not merged with it
